name: PaperAnalyst
description: Search the local PDF corpus, inspect workflow handoff artifacts, fetch external paper references, and answer from paper evidence.

tools.name: scrape_papers_with_mcp
tools.description: Search PDFs with the MCP paper server and return normalized ranked results.

tools.name: fetch_external_paper_with_mcp
tools.description: Fetch external paper metadata or a compact preview from URL, DOI, or arXiv ID.

tools.name: load_paper_memory_with_mcp
tools.description: Load workflow-scoped paper memory for the current query.

tools.name: expand_paper_memory_with_mcp
tools.description: Expand workflow paper memory with full text for the most relevant papers.

tools.name: query_paper_memory
tools.description: Query loaded paper memory and return the most relevant snippets quickly.

instruction_preview: Inspect input_artifacts first, fetch external paper references when needed, reuse workflow_id across memory tools, and answer from evidence while stating when only metadata is available.

name: SocialMediaAnalyst
description: Search SNS posts via MCP and summarize relevant social signals.

tools.name: scrape_sns_with_mcp
tools.description: Search SNS JSON posts via the MCP server and return normalized results.

instruction_preview: Choose search queries from user intent, collect relevant SNS posts, summarize the strongest signals, and clearly state when evidence is weak.

name: WebSearchAnalyst
description: Search the web via the Tavily-backed MCP server and synthesize citation-grounded evidence.

tools.name: search_web_with_mcp
tools.description: Query the Tavily-backed web-search MCP server and return normalized ranked results.

instruction_preview: Choose search queries from user intent, gather reliable web evidence with citations, and when paper-specific evidence is needed, hand off to PaperAnalyst with candidate URLs, DOI, or arXiv IDs.
